description: Python script for generating and testing certificate chains with various name constraints and SANs, used for unit testing certificate validation limits.

methods.name: add_excluded_name_constraints
methods.description: Adds excluded name constraints to a certificate with specified counts for DNS, IP, directory names, and URIs.

methods.name: add_permitted_name_constraints
methods.description: Adds permitted name constraints to a certificate with specified counts for DNS, IP, directory names, and URIs.

methods.name: add_sans
methods.description: Adds Subject Alternative Names (SANs) to a certificate with specified counts for DNS, IP, directory names, and URIs.

methods.name: make_chain
methods.description: Creates a certificate chain with specified constraints and SANs, and writes it to a file.
